said.text: I'm proud to sponsor this legislation because everyone, every worker deserves a basic right; the right to know what is being written about them in their personnel file and how it may impact their livelihood, their future opportunities and their reputation.

did.text: Voted Yes on S3460, which requires employers to give employees access to their personnel records and notice when negative information is added to them. Passed Assembly 92–49.

whyNote: The statement is Assemblymember González-Rojas's explanation of her vote on the Assembly floor, delivered as the vote on this bill was recorded. She sponsors the Assembly companion (A2107) and voted yes.
